scope: Twelve researched hotel/resort candidates for Coachella Valley retreat decisions, supplemented by separate private/service research. Not a complete market ranking, live availability feed or price comparison.

research_method.definition: Sum of numResults requested in Exa search calls, including candidates later excluded; direct fetches are additional.
research_method.provider_discovery: Stripe Directory prerequisites were inspected by lead. Directory/CLI unavailable; no Directory verification performed and no commerce infrastructure installed.
research_method.verification: Published official-source desk research; no business contact, attestation, on-site inspection or availability lookup.
research_method.qualification: Official business/brand group or meeting pathway and on-property lodging. Named layouts qualify working-session capacity only where explicitly published.
research_method.source_date_note: 2026-10-07 is the research check date, not venue inspection, original publication or availability date.

audit.node_dates: All six existing venue nodes were last_updated 2026-09-25; no node date advanced.
